notes.title: Somebody and Something to Love
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37737996/d8e0c9b75a2a91209677809cee1aa1ea0e61d124.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Get yourself immersed in a world of summer, prophecies, and fate. All for less!

Between March 13 and 20, treat yourself to any of the DLC at a cool 27% off. This includes things like the Original Soundtrack, the Artbook, AND the Peanut love route! Don’t have the base game yet? Not to worry, that’s available for the same sweet discount as the extras.

We love you so hard.

notes.title: Shout Shout
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37737996/46e2e8dee24ff4905ad24664ab780bd05c560aaa.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps,

Hush Hush may be all about secrets, but there’s no need to keep this sale on the down-low! In fact, you should probably shout about it from the rooftops or something. The people deserve to know how steep this discount is!

How steep IS the discount, you ask? Well, we’re offering 69% off everything - the Hush Hush base game AND its DLC! (There’s just one exception: Peanut’s DLC is too new and too shiny to put on sale yet.) But the discount DOES apply to everything else, like the (gorgeous) official artbook and the (stunning and amazing) original soundtrack! Those descriptions are totally objective and factual, by the way.

So if you’ve been waiting for a very nice price drop to check out Hush Hush and a bunch of its bonus goodies, well, it doesn’t get much better than this. The sale runs from December 19, 2024 to January 2, 2025 - a whole two weeks! We hope you’ll treat yourself, because you deserve it! It’s the season of giving, after all, and that totally includes self-giving. Yup.

We love you so hard!

The Pandas

notes.title: No Secrets Here
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37737996/15eaa2cdce670eb4a5d9691fd3b87766a48070d7.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

We’re shouting this one from the rooftops! From November 27th to December 4th, the Hush Hush base game AND its DLC are on sale for 30% off. That includes the fun and flirty OST and the gorgeous 195-page Artbook!

You deserve to treat yourself to the sunny, summer-y fantasy that is Hush Hush - especially if you, like us, are entering into the colder and darker months of the year. The love of a few gorgeous girls will surely warm our spirits and keep us smiling!

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: The Peanut DLC
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37737996/f5b1efbcfbf8e0f3aaf6c1f5d5d151968cfb1ec1.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Let’s get right to the important part: you can now romance Peanut in Hush Hush!

This is not a drill. You can now romance Peanut. IN HUSH HUSH.

That’s right, the Peanut DLC is [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2564190/Hush_Hush__Peanut_DLC/]available now[/url]  and unlocks a brand new bonus dating route with the bookish beauty herself. Enjoy a dozen sweet encounters, new text message chit chats, and three full-fledged dates! To round it out, Peanut also gets 10 new outfits and her very own airport ending scene. That’s a TON of new artwork and fully voiced dialogue - it’s basically a whole new game! At the very least, it’s a reeeally nice distraction from the burden of doing all that “chosen one” stuff, hehe.

We've also added a few new Peanut scenes to the base game for free, but it won't work if you just go loading a save file. Since you need to meet her on July 5, it's easiest to start a fresh game.

We’re SO excited for you to experience this new addition to Hush Hush. So, on that note, we won’t keep you. Go forth and play!

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37737996/30043f65dd623d36dcd08bf7f5cb539f017df7e0.png[/img]

Hush Hush may be all about secrets, but we’re not gonna gatekeep this epic summer sale! From June 27 to July 11, you can get Hush Hush and its DLC (There’s a soundtrack! There’s an ART BOOK!) for a whopping 40% off! That’s a LOT of bang for your buck, if we do say so ourselves.

Treat yourself to some DLC, like the Original Soundtrack or the Artbook, as a reward for being so on top of things.

We love you so hard!

notes.title: Done Done
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37737996/64b23a9a177500813b834582c958a5eab769e32d.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

Today’s the day! The sun is shining (hopefully), the birds are singing (probably), and Hush Hush is out of Early Access (officially)!

First of all, we want to say thank you so much to everyone who played the Early Access edition of Hush Hush. The game is finally polished to a glistening sheen now, and that’s largely thanks to the amazing feedback from you!

Now the game is ready to be shared far and wide, so if you haven’t had a chance to play it yet, or if you’re interested in seeing all the wonderful shiny goodness we’ve added, please do check it out and let us know what you think!

One more thing - to celebrate this momentous occasion, we’re offering 10% off the base game from April 20 to 27! Tell your friends, tell your enemies, tell your pets - tell everyone!

And again, thank you. We truly love you SO hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Hush Hush 0.320
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I hope your week is going well so far!  We've got a brand new Hush Hush build with a couple of fixes for everyone to try out.

[list]
[*] Updated the credits with additional information for audio help
[*] Fixed a load game issue if the game was started using a DLC and then a game was loaded without that DLC
[*] Fixed a duplicate line from occurring in Iro's Date 5
[*] Replaced an audio file in Mio's Intro, as well as audio files in Alpha Date 2, Cassie Date 5 and a scene with Fumi
[*] Fixed several typos
[*] Added a new crowd audio loop that is used in Alpha Date 2
[/list]

Thanks again for trying out Hush Hush while it is in early access!

- Sad Panda

notes.title: Hush Hush 0.317
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We hope you're having a great weekend so far!  We have quite a few small quality of life improvements coming into the Hush Hush build today.

[list]
[*] Fixed inconsistency with character sprites during Elle Date 5
[*] Fixed an incorrect voiceover line in Cassie Date 4
[*] Artist Panda re-recorded a line of dialogue in Mio's Intro
[*] Added support for escape and arrow keys to interact with many of the in-game popups (escape will close windows, left/right will navigate pages left/right)
[*] Added padding to the achievements page to fix a visual glitch when controller support is enabled
[*] Smoothed out animating of the affection bar if you mouse back over it while it is closing
[*] Addressed a few places where ultra-wide aspect ratio monitors made the game behave odd, including the bottom navigation bar and scene that had a parallax effect (such as the beach during Iro's Intro)
[/list]

Please let us know if you run into any issues with this new build!  Cheers,

- Sad Panda

notes.title: Build 0.310 Patch Notes
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

I hope you're having a great start to your week!  This is a quick new build to fix an issue with our last patch.

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that caused one character to display as a white square instead of loading their assets properly.
[/list]

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: Spring has Sprung
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37737996/c381043b431223ecb6a2387fce7f87e6a3e0f387.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

Long time no flirt! We wanted to let you in on some Hush Hush updates, plus draw your attention to the sweet sale that’s currently happening. Up until March 23, the Hush Hush base game and all its DLC (that includes the gorgeous Artbook and the OST) are 15% off! What a wonderful time to snatch up a little treat for yourself or gift to friends.

In terms of updates, we’ve been busy fixing bugs and polishing things to a high shine. Here’s a list of what we’ve done:

[list]
[*] Switched to using a new controller input system, which enables support for both touch screen and controllers
[*] Fixed several controller issues (thanks to everyone who reported bugs!)
[*] Placed a delay between successive ‘toasts' when an achievement is earned
[*] Fixed a bug where it was impossible to earn a perfect score when taking Elle on her fourth date
[*] Fixed several audio lines
[*] Added a tip to the phone message screen that suggests it is possible to tap the screen to speed up messages
[*] Made adjustments to Iro’s chapter 5 scene
[/list]

We hope these changes will further improve your gaming experience. As always, keep letting us know what you think!

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Hush Hush Updates & Controller Support
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37737996/1df167591865c31c6612edb83d36569729103097.png[/img]

Hey Panda Peeps!

We’re releasing a new build of Hush Hush just in time for the holidays, featuring a few bug fixes as well as an exciting (and slightly experimental) new feature - controller support! Once enabled in your game settings, you’ll be able to wrap yourself in blankets, recline in your comfiest chair, and barely move while you play. It’s the best!

We highly encourage you to grab your Steam Deck or game controller and check it out. We’d love to hear what you think, especially as we continue to polish and perfect this feature.

Don’t forget, Hush Hush is also on sale right now for 15% off! That deal lasts until January 5th, but the ability to play with your controller… lasts forever.

We love you so hard!

notes.title: The Story of Hush Hush
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37737996/e071100118e7782d26737aba51853b286e3290e6.png[/img]
Hey Panda Peeps!

First and foremost, thank you all so much for the incredible love and support you’ve shown for Hush Hush over the past few months. Your feedback has been amazing, and it’s been a joy to hear about the myriad ways this visual novel has delighted you, excited you, surprised you, and most importantly, tugged at your heartstrings.

Just knowing that Hush Hush wrapped you up in its arms and whisked you away from the real world for a while makes us so incredibly happy. But if you’re inclined to show the game a little extra love during this year’s Steam Awards, that would be beyond amazing. All you have to do is go to [url=https://store.steampowered.com/steamawards/nominations/76561198261483328?k=2061362063176689474]My Steam Award Nominations[/url] and nominate Hush Hush in the “Outstanding Story-Rich Game” category!

Either way, we’re so looking forward to seeing which games get spotlighted during this year's event. It’s sure to be a good one.

We love you so hard,

The Pandas

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.288
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Happy Friday!  We're here with a patch for Hush Hush just in time for the weekend.  We hope you enjoy checking out the latest content!  Here's what has changed since the last build:

[list]
[*] Added new phone flings from Cassie, Elle, Iro and Mio that give some additional context to their death scenes
[*] Added a few missing font characters that were using a fallback font
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the game over screen to not get awarded to the gallery
[*] Added some missing entries to the credits
[*] Added an indicator on save files to indicate whether a DLC was used when saving
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the gameover hint to be missing for one of Quill's death scenes
[*] Fixed several typos
[/list]

Thanks again for trying out Hush Hush, and we hope you have a great weekend!

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.284
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We're here with another batch of fixes for Hush Hush, hopefully squashing a few of those bugs that have been lingering.  Here's what we've been up to this last week:

[list]
[*] Fixed a bug that could cause some scenes to not reload properly if you reload them from within that same scene (for example, you're in Mio's first date and then you decide to load a save file that is also in the middle of Mio's first date)
[*] Disabled the save/load button while in the middle of running a job or skill
[*] Fixed the 'Like a Virgin', 'Wreathed in Light' and 'The Shadow's Embrace'  in-game achievements
[*] Imported new Lilianna assets for Mio's second date
[*] Fixed a few typos and voiceover issues
[/list]

Thanks for trying out our early access build of Hush Hush, and please let us know if you run into any bugs!  Cheers,

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.280
notes.content:
Hello everyone, I hope you're having a great week!  We have a new build with lots of content, and we hope you enjoy trying it out!  Thanks to everyone for submitting your bug reports and helping us make this game even better!

Here's a list of what changed with this build:

[list]
[*] Added achievement counts to the top of the achievement page
[*] Modifications to achievements page such as spacing and raycasting
[*] Extend support for animations to the Gallery (may be useful for future or other content)
[*] Allow key bindings to be disabled via the settings popup
[*] Add additional save slots
[*] Fixed up several audio files and typos
[*] Fixed a few in-game achievements that were impossible to earn
[*] Fixed issue with some Fumi death scenes that were causing the background to swap to an unrelated death scene
[*] Large changes to Bonnibel's second date and Elle's fourth date
[*] Fixed a few dates where it was impossible to earn an A+ in some situations
[/list]

Thanks again for playing Hush Hush!

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: Patch Notes for 0.274
notes.content:
Hey everyone!  I hope you're having a great week so far.  I'm here with a new build and the latest patch notes, we really hope you enjoy the changes!

[list]
[*] Added a few keyboard shortcuts at the request of the community (tab will 'skip' just like pressing the 'skip' button, left control will skip while it is held down)
[*] Added 3 different difficulty modes, which can be selected after starting a new game.  Note:  Any existing old saves will assume the hard difficult mode.  We've also added 3 new in-game achievements and Steam achievements for these different modes.
[*] Added a prompt before loading a save to avoid any misclicks
[*] Fixed several typos and incorrect audio
[*] Reduced the difficulty of the first week
[*] Fixed a bug that caused the next stat to be awarded by the Cafe to be lost when loading a save, resulting in consistent play throughs
[*] Added heart particles to the tutorial
[*] Fixed a bug that would incorrectly show the easter egg text on the date completion dialog in some cases
[/list]

Thanks so much for playing Hush Hush, and please send any bug reports to our support e-mail at support@sadpandastudios.com and we'll do our best to track them down.

Sincerely,

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: 0.266 - Patch Notes Edition!
notes.content:
Hello!  I'm here to provide some patch notes on what has changed in the game since our initial release version (0.256).  The answer is, we've been hard at work!  Here's a list of what we've done in game so far:

[list]
[*] Fixed multiple issues with the gallery (unlocking or not unlocking when images should have)
[*] Fixed a bug that caused two Steam achievements to not unlock correctly (buff and suave achievements)
[*] Fixed a bug where the effect applied to music/sfx in the settings popup was not resetting properly if the settings popup was closed by opening the gallery
[*] Fixed a bug where an A was awarded instead of an A+ when acing a date
[*] Fixed a bug with Cassie's final date and one option being unavailable
[*] Worked on improving the game memory footprint by unloading unused assets when transitioning to the maps screen
[*] Split assets up to improve loading performance in some cases
[*] Tried to improve loading performance and hangs while loading
[*] Fixed several typos and audio issues
[/list]

We've got more patches in the works, and we'll likely have a new build for you to try out tomorrow.  Thanks so much for playing Hush Hush!

- Sad Panda Programmer

notes.title: Great launch day!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37737996/6e49a0a7703cd9172a32373119b4a1c694f31f9e.png[/img]
Thanks everyone who downloaded our game on day 1 - that was an incredible feeling being able to finally release this game to the world! We really appreciate all the feedback, bug reports, and reviews we’ve been receiving. We wanted to give you an update on what we’re doing next to address all this awesome feedback:

[list]
[*] Bug fixing - If you find anything wonky, please post it on the steam forums, or email support@sadpandastudios.com  We’re trying to prioritize the bigger bugs first and have already deployed a few new builds to fix up some things players have reported to us. You’re awesome!

[*] Improve U/X - There are some areas that still need cleaning up with the UI, UX, and userflow so we’ll be looking at those after the bug fixes. Many players have given some great suggestions for things we can do to improve these items. Like for example, did you know you could click the phone messages to have them appear faster? Yeah! [i](that should probably be explained somewhere in the UI…lol)[/i]

[*] Balance - Some feedback has highlighted the game’s difficulty, so we are working to soften some of the balance. As a sidenote, we can track which endings players are running into the most and it seems to be Cassie’s Pizza death, so we’ll start by making her route less punishing! We’re also wanting to add some stats to the end screens showing what % of players have run into the same bad end.

[*] Polish - Since launch, we’ve already made improvements to how the assets are streamed into the game, so the filesize is lighter and load time goes quick! We've still got a few art polish tasks we need to fix up, so you might notice some visual improvements in future builds.

[*] Audio - There are a few audio files that aren’t playing so we’ll track down what’s going on with those, and will adjust the filter on the ones players report as sounding too quiet/too loud.
[/list] 

We've also pinned a thread for the most commonly asked questions, which you can find [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/782250/discussions/0/3426696555565878062/]here[/url]. We'll keep adding to it as we receive more questions from players.

Thanks for playing Hush Hush and letting us know what you think! It’s very humbling seeing how many people are in-game, and everyone helping us find bugs/things we can improve is amazing!!
We love you so hard,
~Sad Panda
